{{Character Infobox |color={{ghost color}} |corecolor={{ghost color light}} |bordercolor={{ghost color dark}} |name=Onia |jname={{tt|コニア|Konia}} |tmname=Conia |text=fff |image=Onia anime.png |size=200px |caption=Onia |age=UnconfirmedAs of ''[[HZ092|Following Traces of Laquium]]'', Onia is a year older than at the start of {{aniseries|HZ}} |gender=Female |hair=Greyish blue |eyes=Blue with pink highlights |hometown=Unknown |region=Unknown }} {{Character Infobox/Anime |color={{ghost color light}} |series=''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]'' |debut=''[[HZ001|The Pendant That Starts It All (Part One)]]'' |enva=[[Lisa Ortiz]] |jpva=[[Arisa Shida]] }} {{Character Infobox/Team |color={{ghost color light}} |member=[[Explorers]] |rank=Agent }} |} '''Onia''' (Japanese: '''コニア''' ''Conia''Explorers Original Acrylic Stand) is a member of the [[Explorers]] and a former supporting antagonist in {{aniseries|HZ}}. She is also [[Amethio]]'s subordinate alongside [[Zirc]]. After Amethio's disappearance, she and Zirc started acting as double agents against [[Spinel]]. ==In animation== ===History=== ====Pre-series==== As revealed in ''[[HZ104|Charcadet's Wish]]'', at some point prior to ''[[HZ001|The Pendant That Starts It All (Part One)]]'', Onia alongside [[Zirc]] joined the Explorers after being recruited by [[Hamber]], who assigned her to serve as [[Amethio]]'s direct subordinate. Onia was ready to take advantage of Amethio's status as Gibeon's grandson and heir to the fortune to rise up the ranks, though as she started working together with him, she eventually came to pledge complete loyalty to him out of respect for his diligence and character. ===={{aniseries|HZ}}==== [[File:Onia and Liko Sprigatito.png|left|250px|thumb|Onia threatening [[Liko]] through her {{TP|Liko|Sprigatito}}]] Onia debuted in ''[[HZ001|The Pendant That Starts It All (Part One)]]'' alongside the other members of the [[Explorers]]. After spotting [[Liko]] hiding on the roof, Onia alerted her teammates and joined them on the roof. When [[Friede]] from the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]] swoop in to defend Liko, [[Amethio]] stopped her and [[Zirc]] from assisting. After Friede escaped with Liko in the [[HZ002|next episode]], her and the rest of the Explorers gave chase, broke through the [[Brave Olivine|airship]]'s defenses, and threatened Liko to give herself up. Friede stopped them from leaving and battled Amethio once more, but they managed to escape after [[Liko's Sprigatito]] unleashed a {{m|Leafage}} strong enough to break the forcefield around the battlefield, taking it as a hostage in the process. In ''[[HZ003|For Sure! 'Cause Sprigatito's with Me!]]'', Onia grew fond of Sprigatito and began pampering it. After she had run out of [[Pokémon food]], Onia went shopping and was spotted by [[Murdock]]'s {{TP|Murdock|Rockruff}}, who immediately alerted the nearby Rising Volt Tacklers and chased her back to the Explorers' hideout. Soon, Onia confronted Liko after she'd reunited with Sprigatito and was disappointed that the Grass Cat Pokémon wanted to stay with Liko. By blinding her and her {{p|Skarmory}} with a Leafage attack, Sprigatito and Liko were able to escape. As of ''[[HZ006|The Ancient Poké Ball]]'', after leaving without a mission to complete, that was now given by [[Spinel]], Onia decided to follow Amethio in order to discover more about the {{Shiny|Black}} [[Black Rayquaza|Rayquaza]] that was summoned from [[Roy]]'s ancient [[Poké Ball]]. In ''[[HZ021|The Lonely Hatenna]]'', Onia with Amethio and Zirc arrived in the [[Galar]] [[region]] in order to investigate the [[Galar Mine]]. In the [[HZ022|next episode]], Onia and his team arrived at the Galar Mine where they came across Liko, Roy, and Friede and they battled them. However, the two groups witnessed a {{rf|Galarian}} {{TP|Lucius|Moltres}} that had an Ancient Poké Ball arrive and attack them. Seeing how powerful Moltres was, Onia and Zirc retreated from their battle against Liko and Roy. In the [[HZ023|following episode]], the two reunited with Amethio and agreed to help him get the {{an|Terapagos|Pokémon}} that was in Liko's pendant. In ''[[HZ024|Reunion at the Ancient Castle!]]'', Onia, Amethio, and Zirc reported their findings to [[Hamber]]. Later, they followed Liko, Roy, and Friede to the [[old castle]] in [[Hammerlocke]] and surrounded them in order to take the Pokémon away. In the [[HZ025|next episode]], Oria tried to prevent Roy and Liko's escape, but failed. However, she was able to find Roy and Liko again, so he and Onia forced them to battle. During the battle, Onia was overwhelmed by Liko's improvement in battle, which led her to lose. In ''[[HZ033|Roar of the Black Rayquaza]]'', Onia, Amethio, and Zirc were able to locate Rayquaza. Amethio told his subordinates to remain on standby whilst he went to confront it. After Amethio's battle against Black Rayquaza in ''[[HZ045|From So Far Away]]'', Onia appeared with Zirc to check if Amethio was okay, then the group returned to the Explorers' base. In ''[[HZ054|The Treasure of Eternity]]'', it was revealed that Onia and Zirc were spying on Spinel under Amethio's orders. [[File:Onia and Zirc HZ087.png|250px|thumb|Onia and [[Zirc]] helping Liko, [[Roy]], and [[Dot]] against their fellow [[Explorers]]]] In ''[[HZ068|Into a New Sky! The Brave Olivine!]]'', following Amethio's temporary ban from the Explorers, Amethio informed Onia that he was planning on going on a mission on his own. Showing loyalty to Amethio, Onia and Zirc insisted on accompanying him. In ''[[HZ083|The Truth Revealed!]]'', Onia, Amethio, and Zirc infiltrated the Exceed building to uncover what Spinel was scheming, only to end up captured by security. They were freed by Hamber, who took them to [[Amethio's mansion]] and told them about Gibeon's past and his association with [[Laqua]]. Believing Spinel was manipulating Gibeon in order to obtain the [[Laquium]] himself, Amethio set for Laqua with Onia and Zirc by his side. In ''[[HZ087|Guided by the Black Rayquaza!]]'', after arriving in Laqua, Onia, and Zirc helped Liko, Roy, and [[Dot]] get past [[Coral]], [[Sidian]], and [[Chalce]], who were guarding where the Laquium was hidden. Though fearful of their superiors' wrath, Onia and Zirc stood by their decision and were prepared to face whatever punishment they received. In ''[[HZ089|Where the Adventure Leads]]'', when Laqua began collapsing due to Spinel's actions, Onia and Zirc returned to Amethio and convinced him to flee the area with them. In ''[[HZ092|Following Traces of Laquium]]'', a year after the events at Laqua, Onia and Zirc had become separated from their boss Amethio, whose whereabouts were unknown. Hamber, not believing Spinel's report that Amethio had betrayed Gibeon and that both had died in Laqua, secretly entrusted Onia and Zirc with a mission to find him as well as the White Zygarde, being given a [[Zygarde Cube]] in doing so. In ''[[HZ101|Terastallization vs. Mega Evolution!]]'', Onia appeared with Zirc somewhere in the sea trying to find Amethio's whereabouts, without success, she asked Zygarde to guide her. In ''[[HZ103|Nidothing Love!]]'', while taking a break from searching for Amethio in [[Levincia]], Onia discovered that Zirc was planning to join a handshake event hosted by Nidothing and {{an|Iono}}. The next day, a gust of wind blew Zirc's ticket into a nearby storm drain. When Liko and her friends happened upon the depressed Zirc, they agreed to help find the ticket. They tracked the ticket to a nearby beach, where it ended up stuck on top of a wild {{p|Wugtrio}}'s head. Everyone battled Wugtrio together, giving Zirc's Rhydon the opportunity to retrieve the ticket. Later, Onia and Zirc approached Liko, where they revealed that Amethio was missing and personally asked her to assist them in finding him. In ''[[HZ104|Charcadet's Wish]]'', after paying a visit to Amethio's mansion, Onia. Zirc, and Liko began looking for clues that would help them determine where Amethio was located. When Liko's {{TP|Liko|Charcadet}} came across one of Amethio's childhood photos, Onia and Zirc called [[Cervantis]], who explained he took the photo while on a family vacation years ago. Off the coast of Levincia, everyone found Amethio alive, but in hiding on an island to avoid being captured by Spinel's agents. Onia and Zirc begged Amethio to take Exceed and the Explorers from Spinel's grasp, but he refused, stating that with Gibeon's passing, he was powerless to do anything. With words of encouragement from Liko and a battle with her Charcadet, Amethio managed to regain the resolve to fight against Spinel's machinations. Despite this, Amethio refused to go with Onia and Zirc, stating that as members of the Explorers, there were things they could accomplish on the inside that he couldn't. Accepting this, Zirc passed on the Zygarde Cube to Amethio before leaving the island with Onia. Afterward, Onia and Zirc reported to Hamber that Amethio was safe and sound. In [[HZ124]], Onia joined forces with Zirc and Amethio's to battle three [[Explorers]]'s [[Golbat (Pokémon)|Golbat]], [[Marowak (Pokémon)|Marowak]], and [[Shelgon (Pokémon)|Shelgon]] to cause a distraction, allowing the Rising Volt Tacklers to infiltrate the Explorers HQ. Later, Amethio contacted her and Zirc to watch the back of the building in case something goes wrong before Dot thanks the pair for their help and Amethio, Liko, Roy, Dot and Ult entered the HQ. In [[HZ134]], Onia, Zirc, and Amethio reunited with Liko on Laqua's summit as she was with [[Diana]], [[Captain Pikachu]], and [[Ann]]. When Spinel utilized his Laquium-activating machines to drive the resident wild Pokémon berserk, Onia lent her aid to help pacify them. After Captain Pikachu and Pagogo destroyed the machines and purified the afflicted Pokémon, Onia and Zirc left with Zygarde to move the Pokémon to safety. ===Character=== [[File:Onia Zirc disguise HZ083.png|250px|thumb|Onia and Zirc disguised as [[Exceed]] employees]] [[File:Onia infatuated.png|thumb|250px|left|Onia infatuated by Liko's Sprigatito]] Amongst the [[Explorers]], Onia appears to be the most ruthless and violent of the trio, going so far as to threaten [[Liko]] through {{TP|Liko|Sprigatito}} to achieve her goals. In ''[[HZ003|For Sure! 'Cause Sprigatito's with Me!]]'', however, Onia demonstrated a much lighter side while monitoring Sprigatito, even to the point of her wanting to keep the Grass Cat Pokémon to herself. More recently, in ''[[HZ104|Charcadet's Wish]]'', it was revealed that these feelings did not change when Onia delivered food especially for [[Liko's Meowscarada]]. Onia has been shown to be quite loyal to [[Amethio]], whether receiving instructions on how to proceed or not interfering with his actions. This was also shown in ''[[HZ068|Into a New Sky! The Brave Olivine!]]'' when she insisted on accompanying Amethio on his mission after being dismissed from the Explorers. As seen in ''[[HZ103|Nidothing Love!]]'', even though she doesn't show it much, Onia does care for [[Zirc]]'s feelings and feels content when he's happy as she went out of her way to help him find his ticket after he lost it and got depressed. She is not too proud to never seek help when it's needed, as seen when she and Zirc both personally asked Liko to help them find Amethio. It was also revealed that she has been a fan of [[Grusha]] since his snowboarding days. In ''[[HZ104|Charcadet's Wish]]'', it's revealed that she and Zirc were a little judgmental of Amethio when they first met him but her perspective of Amethio changed overtime and she became completely loyal to him and wants to help him showing she cares for Amethio as a friend and superior. ===Pokémon=== This listing is of Onia's only known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|HZ}}: ====On hand==== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Onia |pkmn=Skarmory |type1=Steel |type2=Flying |img=Onia Skarmory.png |epnum=HZ002 |epname=The Pendant That Starts It All (Part Two) |vajp= |vaen=Marc Thompson |desc={{p|Skarmory}} is Onia's first known Pokémon. She used it as her main mean of transportation. In ''[[HZ003|For Sure! 'Cause Sprigatito's with Me!]]'', Onia sent out Skarmory to battle [[Liko]] and her {{TP|Liko|Sprigatito}}, only for them to escape after blinding it with {{m|Leafage}}. In ''[[HZ083|The Truth Revealed!]]'', Skarmory, along with Onia's {{p|Golduck}}, as well as [[Zirc]] and [[Amethio]]'s Pokémon, were all confiscated by [[Spinel]]'s personal security when they infiltrated [[Exceed]], but were later retrieved by [[Hamber]]. Skarmory's only known move is {{m|Whirlwind}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Onia |pkmn=Golduck |type1=Water |img=Onia Golduck.png |epnum=HZ005 |epname=Found You, Fuecoco! |vajp=Daiki Yamashita |vaen=Marc Thompson |desc={{p|Golduck}} is Onia's second known Pokémon and her main partner. In ''[[HZ005|Found You, Fuecoco!]]'', Onia sent out Golduck to battle the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]] before confronting [[Liko]] and her {{TP|Liko|Sprigatito}}, only to be defeated. In ''[[HZ022|Charge! Galar Mine!]]'', Golduck was sent out by Onia to battle against Liko and Sprigatito again at the [[Galar Mine]]. Just as Golduck was about to make contact with its {{m|Scratch}}, [[Captain Pikachu]] sent it flying with a super-effective {{m|Volt Tackle}}. When [[Lucius's Moltres]] appeared, it attacked everyone in sight and Golduck ended up getting knocked out by its {{m|Air Slash}} attack, prompting Onia to [[recall]] her Pokémon and flee. In ''[[HZ024|Reunion at the Ancient Castle!]]'', Golduck joined [[Zirc]]'s {{p|Rhydon}} and [[Amethio's Ceruledge]] in ambushing the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]] and [[Diana]] at the [[old castle]] in [[Hammerlocke]]. In the [[HZ025|next episode]], it battled Liko's Sprigatito again, but due to Sprigatito's expert usage of {{m|Leafage}} to blind it, Golduck was ultimately knocked out and promptly recalled by Onia. In ''[[HZ083|The Truth Revealed!]]'', Golduck, along with Onia's {{p|Skarmory}}, as well as Zirc and [[Amethio]]'s Pokémon, were all confiscated by [[Spinel]]'s personal security when they infiltrated [[Exceed]], but were later retrieved by [[Hamber]], and Golduck happily reunited with its {{pkmn|Trainer}}. It later enjoyed a meal at [[Amethio's mansion]] and confidently agreed with Onia in regards to assisting Amethio with his decision to reach [[Laqua]]. In ''[[HZ087|Guided by the Black Rayquaza!]]'', Golduck and Rhydon attacked [[Coral]]'s {{p|Glalie}}, [[Sidian]]'s {{p|Garganacl}}, and [[Chalce]]'s {{p|Medicham}} with {{m|Muddy Water}} and {{m|Rock Slide}}, respectively, allowing Liko, [[Roy]], and [[Dot]] to pass and reach [[Gibeon]]. In [[HZ124]], Golduck joined forces with Zirc's Rhydon and Amethio's Ceruledge to battle three [[Explorers]]'s {{p|Golbat}}, {{p|Marowak}}, and {{p|Shelgon}} to cause a distraction, allowing the Rising Volt Tacklers to infiltrate the Explorers HQ. Onia revealed in ''[[HZ103|Nidothing Love!]]'' that Golduck has very sensitive skin and has difficulty swimming in sea water because of this condition.
